# Module: `icescopy_droplet_detection`

Trains and runs a random-forest detector from marked droplet circles.

[Source](../src/icescopy_droplet_detection.py) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

Builds image features and training labels from complete circle annotations, augments images and circles together, and trains with scikit-learn. The detector reads validated numeric trees from JSON and predicts new circles with NumPy and OpenCV. This model format is separate from the neural detector's ONNX bundles.

## Classes

| Class | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [`CancelledError`](API-Class-CancelledError.md) | Signals that droplet training or detection was cancelled. |
| [`Circle`](API-Class-icescopy-droplet-detection-Circle.md) | Stores a circle center and radius for random-forest detection and training. |
| [`RandomForestDetector`](API-Class-RandomForestDetector.md) | Evaluates validated decision trees and converts predicted regions into circles. |
